raw.notable_prerequisites: You have at least one red card in hand.
raw.steps:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Horde Ambusher, adding {C}{C}.
When Horde Ambusher dies, Missy's first ability triggers, returning Horde Ambusher from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Activate Horde Ambusher's morph ability by revealing a red card from your hand, turning it face up.
Repeat.

raw.notable_prerequisites: You control another nontoken nonartifact creature.
raw.steps:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nontoken nonartifact creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Missy's first ability and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Missy trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield face down as a 2/2 Cyberman artifact creature.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Activate Ixidor by paying {2}{U}, turning the creature face up.
Repeat.
